lastResponse.text: I hear you. This is an emergency right now. Please tell shelter staff: “I might pass out, I can’t keep food down, and I’m having trouble breathing.” Ask them to call nine one one now and stay with you. Do not go outside alone. Sit down, lean forward, and stay where people can see you. After nine one one is on the Way, I can help with food support next.
originalTexts: I hear you. This is an emergency right now. Please tell shelter staff: “I might pass out, I can’t keep food down, and I’m having trouble breathing.” Ask them to call **911** now and stay with you. Do not go outside alone. Sit down, lean forward, and stay where people can see you. After 911 is on the way, I can help with food support next.
